description: Runs the email-authentication check of one domain and returns a machine-readable, NON-BINDING quote for Fix & Verify: price (EUR 99 net per domain), scope (exact DNS changes), acceptance criteria and the baseline to verify against later. Orders are not open: it creates no order, contract or payment and stores nothing. Keep the returned criteria and baseline to call verifyFixVerify after the records are published.
name: quoteFixVerify
title: Scope and quote Fix & Verify for a domain
